verified_source_findings.subject: Owned creation/accept and checked flags
verified_source_findings.finding: socket/accept success is checked before exactly one OwnedFd transfer; Darwin configure owns the fd across all fallible work. F_GETFL/F_SETFL preserve existing status flags while adding O_NONBLOCK; F_GETFD/F_SETFD preserve descriptor flags while adding FD_CLOEXEC. Both are read back. Each of six failures propagates immediately; no-op setters with missing flags return InvalidData. No partially configured fd returns Ok. EINTR/WouldBlock accept returns None. Failed connect/bind/chmod/listen also drops its owned fd.

verified_source_findings.subject: Real credentials without fallback or PID authorization
verified_source_findings.finding: Darwin UID/GID come only from checked getpeereid; PID only from checked SOL_LOCAL/LOCAL_PEERPID. Exact pid_t length, positive PID and overwritten UID/GID sentinels are required. No own-UID/getpid/zero fallback exists. Kernel source returns peer socket last_pid, and last-owner updates make this different from Linux connection-time creator PID. Leaf comments and README state this distinction and non-atomic snapshot limit. The existing admission predicates compare UID only, unchanged. Checked baseline chonk-shell control.rs:902 refuses lookup error; chonk-hyprland-ipc server.rs:1004/1018 uses unwrap_or(false). No IPC peer PID authorizes or signals a process at those inspected call sites. Other Wayland window.pid origins and Astra's new callgraph are outside this review.

verified_source_findings.subject: Darwin sockaddr layout correct; stale endpoint decision blocked by F1
verified_source_findings.finding: Path bytes reject NUL and lengths >= sun_path capacity (104 on Darwin), remain zero-terminated, set AF_UNIX, and set sun_len/passed length to offset(sun_path)+path_bytes+1. XNU header confirms sun_len includes NUL. Revision001 conservatively preserves a path for most probe outcomes, but ECONNREFUSED still reaches remove_file. That exception is unsafe: pinned XNU uses it for a live full listener queue and other live-listener connection-allocation failures. Therefore this decision tree does not establish staleness and cannot be admitted; see F1. Existing unrelated path/drop races and Stream::from_fd behavior remain inherited APIs, not newly qualified guarantees.

verified_source_findings.subject: Linux behavior and original tests
verified_source_findings.finding: Linux still creates sockets atomically with SOCK_CLOEXEC|SOCK_NONBLOCK, uses accept4 with both flags, and uses the same SO_PEERCRED function body. The shared socket helper refactors two identical original creation calls into one without changing Linux operations. Normalized original peer_credentials_of, both UID admission predicates, uid helper, send_on and wait_readable bodies are identical; both original test bodies are byte-identical. Accept ownership construction is a semantic refactor only. Added Darwin stale guard is cfg(macos), so the original Linux stale decision tree remains unchanged.

verified_source_findings.subject: Existing send flags
verified_source_findings.finding: Existing MSG_NOSIGNAL use is retained. Pinned XNU socket.h defines MSG_NOSIGNAL=0x80000; this review does not infer target send execution from that source definition.

This establishes ownership retirement and ordinary host close behavior, not checked close-error acknowledgement or guaranteed kernel closure under a close failure. A primary fcntl error still returns Err; this omission does not turn partial configuration into Ok.

confirmed_blockers.title: Darwin ECONNREFUSED cannot authorize stale-path unlink

source_chain.fact: AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM has PR_CONNREQUIRED, selecting the connection-allocation branch.
Even when SO_ACCEPTCONN is set, a NULL sonewconn result is translated to ECONNREFUSED.

sonewconn delegates to sonewconn_internal. The internal function returns NULL on a full accept queue and also memory/accounting/allocation failures. Queue threshold depends on soqlimitcompat (qlimit or3*qlimit/2); no fixed observed target queue threshold is claimed.
WouldBlock preserves a live owner, but Darwin ECONNREFUSED bypasses the macOS guard and executes remove_file. A new listener can then replace a stalled live owner's pathname.

confirmed_blockers.scope: Source-established failure path; no claim that a queue-full steal was executed on Darwin or hardware. Linux full-queue errno and unchanged Linux behavior are separate from this Darwin path.
confirmed_blockers.resolution_direction: Refuse every existing Darwin endpoint unless a separately reviewed ownership proof exists; the minimal root002 policy simply refuses existing paths, with no lock or broad stale-recovery feature added.

correction.effect: The preliminary revision001 source approval was too broad: it checked the guarded errno decision without verifying that ECONNREFUSED distinguished stale from live on pinned XNU. That approval is revoked for the reviewed001 stale recovery. All original test/provenance observations remain; passing Linux tests did not exercise the Darwin ambiguity.
